partsconnexion.com.title: Server Memory and Log Optimization
partsconnexion.com.note: This work covers the PartsConnexion server, which also serves AudioConnexion.

memory.summary: Server memory use stayed steady at about 25% this month, well within normal limits.

serverLogs.before: The server recorded far more log entries than were useful, which made problems harder to find and slowed troubleshooting.
serverLogs.after: Logs are now cleaner, shorter and easier to read.
improvements: Better visibility of how the store is running
